title: Isilumkiso Esincinci Phambi Komntu Oza Kubamba I-Marching
intro: Ngena entlanjeni apho umlawuli onamandla kunye nomkhosi omkhulu besondela, uze ube nombono womhambi omncinci enika isilumkiso esisindisa uluntu lonke. Njengoko uluntu olusengozini lufika kwindawo yokukhosela, ingozi iyadlula. Landela izikhokelo ukuze ufumane umntu ongakhathalelwanga emva kweso silumkiso.
clues: Ndiphakathi kwezidalwa ezincinci ezinxulumene nobukumkani bomlawuli.
Uluntu lwam luhlala kwizindlu ezingaphakathi kwentlambo, apho omnye wethu angabiza abanye.
Sijongene nosongelo oluvela kuloo mlawuli kunye nemikhosi ehamba nomlawuli.
Ndingulowo ubiza uluntu lwam ukuba lungene emakhayeni alo kwaye usilumkisa ukuba singacinezelwa singazi.
Umlawuli nguSulayman, kwaye uhlobo lwam luphakathi kwezidalwa ezibekwe phantsi komyalelo wakhe.
Ndingumbungu waloo ntlambo; emva kwesilumkiso sam, sangena emakhayeni ethu saza sasinda ekutyunyuzweni okwakungasibamba singalindelanga.

arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَـٰبٍۢ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًۭا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verse: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt. (29:48)
